dependency_with_a1: A1 freezes the family-neutral adapter interface this lane implemented (PLAN section 6) and resolves any drift against G2/G3 lane outputs before integration.

A1 supplies the real scored-window launch path: this lane deliberately produced no scored metric, so A1 must wire publish_trial() to the actual scored run and confirm the ledger path (default results/registry/experiments.jsonl) and matrix_id vocabulary.

M01 plugin expects bars injected by the caller (research.hyp_a8_m01.load_block_universe / read_bars_15m); A1 decides whether real data loads happen in the harness or via a G2-funded loader, and supplies per-symbol tick sizes plus native settlement series.
Benchmark context symbols and the pinned exclusion come from the plugin (hyp_a8_m01.BENCHMARK_SYMBOL_EXCLUDED); if A1 changes the cohort contract, only the plugin file changes.

design_notes.accounting_convention: Each boundary is a mark-to-market close/reopen: legs are valued at the fill price when traded and at the strategy mark otherwise; price PnL, native funding accrual (LONG_PAYS_POSITIVE_RATE over (start,end]) and one-side turnover cost are recorded per decision instant; entry cost is allocated pro-rata over the established book, a liquidating transition's cost over the legs being closed.
design_notes.drop_one_fold: The dropped fold keeps its instants in the ledger but is flagged dropped and excluded from the scored fold table.
plugins: research/adapter_v10/m01_plugin.py (thin wrappers over research/hyp_a8_m01 primitives; hyp_a8_m01.py itself untouched)
design_notes.purge_semantics: Instants no fold claims (purge gaps and the trailing force-flat edge) never open a book: holdings carry through unchanged, so a position opened in fold k always closes inside fold k and the runner refuses any spill; purge-gap rows stay in the ledger but roll into the fold they trail.

head_sha_scope: branch HEAD the single G1 lane commit sits on (measured before the lane commit). An artifact cannot embed the hash of the commit that carries it; the lane commit SHA is reported to A1 in the G1 return message and every input file is pinned byte-exactly by input_hashes below, which stay valid across cherry-picks.
limitations: No scored V10 cell was run and no real catalog data was read: M01 numbers in the tests are synthetic, so this lane proves the adapter mechanics, not M01 performance.

The fold metric engine implements realized after-cost/funding accounting with mark-to-market boundary closes; it does not reproduce any existing V9/V10 harness PnL and must be reconciled by A1 before any scored publication uses it for a verdict.

Funding accrual for the M01 plugin normalises and accrues each symbol's settlement series separately (a merged cross-symbol series would trip the strict duplicate-stamp check on shared settlement instants).

Stress cells are symbolic parameter changes on each strategy's own cost floors (x1.5 fee, +2 ticks, +1 event delay, drop first sorted symbol, drop fold index 0) exactly as preregistered; no re-tuning was done.

Publication uses kind=CELL_RESULT rows with a deterministic trial_key_sha256; the scored-trial denominator counts those rows, so A1 must keep other lanes from appending foreign CELL_RESULT rows to the same ledger path during a rerun.
reasons: BG1: fold-level realized after-cost/funding metrics (position PF per contract_v10.PF_DEFINITION_V10, daily expectancy, additive max drawdown, hit rate) produced per chronological fold with purge/embargo attribution and a final force-flat boundary; two independent builds hash identically.

BG2: generic target-book normaliser accepts mapping / [[sym,w]] / {weights,...} shapes, single-sources sign semantics into longs/shorts, and refuses |w| > 0.30 (0.30 itself accepted); fill-level and portfolio/scoring payloads are emitted per boundary.

BG4: six named cells (baseline + contract_v10.STRESS_MATRIX_V10) each run end-to-end with their own artifact file and unique result/shard/log roots; drop_one_fold removes a fold from the scored table without leaking its rows.

BG5: flat hard benchmark is exactly 0.0 everywhere and refuse to emit otherwise; buy-and-hold and benchmark-excluded neutral are context-only (enters_denominator=false), with the excluded leg never a tradeable member.

BG6: publication is idempotent and exactly-once over research/global_ledger (snapshot/digest/append_verified): first publish +1 denominator, same key refused, pre-score failure appends nothing, violated append-only ledger refuses, rerun never double-counts.

Genericity: no family/arm/trial identifier in any shared module (grep + test guard); strategy enters only via the ResearchStrategy protocol; dummy strategy and the thin M01 plugin pass the same parameterized suite.
No scored V10 metric was created in this lane: every number in the tests comes from synthetic frames.
Fail-closed paths verified: unavailable valuation marks raise DataUnavailable, duplicate settlement stamps are refused by the shared PIT hook, and settlements outside every held span accrue nothing.
